scripts.render: npm run render:video && npm run render:poster && npm run render:readme
scripts.render:poster: ffmpeg -version | grep -q '^ffmpeg version 8\.1 ' && ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -i output/publish/canaryd-core-stories.mp4 -ss 3.35 -frames:v 1 output/publish/poster.png
scripts.render:readme: ffmpeg -version | grep -q '^ffmpeg version 8\.1 ' && ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -i output/publish/canaryd-core-stories.mp4 -filter_complex "fps=10,scale=860:-2:flags=lanczos,split[s0][s1];[s0]palettegen=max_colors=128:stats_mode=diff[p];[s1][p]paletteuse=dither=sierra2_4a:diff_mode=rectangle" -loop 0 output/publish/canaryd-core-stories.gif
